summary: Turn 17. The obligation submission was accepted and created unit-CLM-DURABLE-BAL, so this turn promotes the construction observation to a formal direct check. The harness is the same internal package-epaxos construction the turn-15 exploration already ran successfully: Durable=true, an os.Pipe StableStore, and one fixed instance with bal=7, vbal=2, Status=ACCEPTED, Seq=5, Deps=[-1,-1,-1]; it emits a CA_EVENT durable_meta_case prerequisite and a CA_EVENT durable_meta_record result carrying the case identity, the raw first four bytes, status, seq, bal_persisted and field0_equals_vbal, and fails only after both events are printed. Since the exploration already showed bal_persisted=false and field0_equals_vbal=true for exactly this input, the property is expected to be violated; the run will record that observation for the controller's attribution.
